name: feature_eng
description: Feature-engineering routing: a one-hot encode request should reach the Feature-Engineering specialist and produce the expected dummy columns. The {{EDA_CSV}} token is replaced with the absolute path to evals/fixtures/eda_sample.csv at run time (see tests/test_eval.py).

parts.text: Load the local CSV at {{EDA_CSV}}, then one-hot encode the region column — go ahead and do it now without asking me to confirm. List the resulting column names.
After one-hot encoding region, the columns are units_sold, revenue, discount_pct, region_North, region_South, and region_West.
